title: Establishing a Reliable Utility-Class Workflow knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Establishing a Reliable Utility-Class Workflow?
options: It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
Tailwind scans complete candidate tokens in source files and generates matching CSS
questions.answer_key: Tailwind scans complete candidate tokens in source files and generates matching CSS
questions.explanation: Establishing a Reliable Utility-Class Workflow is best understood through the syllabus topics: Writing complete utility names, Keeping class names understandable, Testing styles after changes. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with establishing a reliable utility-class workflow?
options: Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
use complete class names or a static map, then inspect the generated output
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
questions.answer_key: use complete class names or a static map, then inspect the generated output
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Writing complete utility names, Keeping class names understandable, Testing styles after changes, Using autocomplete and editor support.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying establishing a reliable utility-class workflow?
options: Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
string interpolation can hide complete class names from source detection
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
questions.answer_key: string interpolation can hide complete class names from source detection
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
